caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden clock case with a rich reddish-brown finish and prominent wood grain. The clock has two substantial cylindrical columns on either side of its front surface, supporting a top section that curves outward at the edges. The upper section of the case contains a square clock face with black Roman numerals, black minute and hour hands, and a visible round mechanism in the center. Below the clock face, there is a smaller square panel featuring a decorative diamond-shaped blue and gold design bordered by intricate gold scrollwork. The lowest section forms a compartment door with a brass knob at its center, showing a more subdued mottled brown surface. The entire clock stands upright, with its form and sections clearly delineated by the careful use of shading and lines. The background of the drawing is plain and beige, with the artist's signature, "LAURENCE PHILLIPS," written near the bottom right of the image.
title: Clock
